vo: A letter from you, at sixty-five.
Dear me. I'm writing to you from the year twenty sixty-one.
You're thirty. You think there's still time. There is, but only if you start.
Saving alone wasn't enough. Prices grew faster than my savings.
What worked was a plan with fixed rules. No panic on loss days. No greed on profit days.
A little every month. Every trade shown. Years, not days.
Thank you for starting. Love, you, at sixty-five.
